title: Readiness Estimator: EMP Protection Standards 2.0
definition: Estimates EMP Protection Standards 2.0 readiness from component maturity.

The estimator scores the six EMP Protection Standards 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a standard hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: EMP Protection Standards 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for EMP Protection Standards 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for EMP Protection Standards 2.0 — next-gen standards against EMP.

Phase 1 — Prove (shielding specs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (standard logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (testing labs): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (critical sites): standard hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and infrastructure-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
